## What's new

- **A new look, laid out like Apple Music.** Cream pages, warm black text and one orange for everything you can tap. In dark mode it's warm charcoal with a brighter orange, and Night mode is still pure black. There are no gradients anymore: the washes, glows and tinted backgrounds are gone, and the album cover is the colour on screen.
- **A new icon: the K in orange on cream.** Settings → Appearance → App icon lets you switch between **Cream**, **Ember** (cream on orange), **Night** (orange on black) and **Classic** (the old blue).
- **Library is a list.** Playlists, Artists, Albums, Songs, Genres, Favourites, Downloads and Radio, with your most recently added albums below. Each opens as its own page with a filter field under the title. This replaces swiping between tabs.
- **Text follows your iPhone's text size.** Set a larger size in Settings → Display & Brightness → Text Size and Kultr follows it everywhere.

## What's different

- **Glass only where things float:** the tab bar, the mini player, toolbar and player buttons, and sheets. Buttons inside pages are solid, sand with an orange label, and the main action on a screen is orange.
- **Home:** tap a shelf's title, like "Played the most ›", to see all of it.
- **Album, artist and playlist pages:** Play and Shuffle are two matching buttons, the all-caps label above the title is gone, and each track's ••• is orange.
- **The player sits on cream** instead of the blurred cover. Year, genre, format, bitrate and rating are one line instead of five pills; the genre and the rating can still be tapped.
- **Settings** has orange symbols instead of coloured tiles.
- **Widgets** are cream in light mode and charcoal in dark.
- **Spacing is even everywhere,** on one scale of 4 to 32 points.

**Your settings:** on the first start after updating, Kultr moves to the new defaults. Periwinkle becomes orange, the colour stops coming from the artwork, and the blurred cover behind pages turns off. A colour you picked yourself is kept. Settings → Appearance turns any of these back on: "Colour from artwork", "Blurred artwork background" and the accent colours.

## Under the hood

- The swipe pager, its tab strip, the filter field, the chips and every gradient are gone. The Library list, the icon picker and the one-time switch to the new defaults take their place, so the app is about the same size.

## Install

Download **Kultr.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac), **Feather** or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. Or add the source `https://gist.githubusercontent.com/evropiani/6e3a3c18525a228d03924674430c4d48/raw/evropiani.json` in SideStore and update from there.

Installing over an earlier version keeps your servers, library, listening history, analysis and downloads — install it with the same Apple ID and don't delete the old app first.
